final_message:
Milk that runs out today now shows up in the "runs out soon" list. All 12 tests pass, including a new one for this case.

The cause was in `pantry/store.py`, in `expiring()`. The window check was `today < i.expires_on <= last`, which dropped anything expiring on `today` itself. I changed it to `today <= i.expires_on <= last`.

The new test is in `tests/test_store.py`. It adds milk expiring 2026-10-21 and asks for the next three days from that date. I didn't replay the recording against the API; the store-level test covers the same case.

I haven't committed anything.
